scripts.typecheck: sh -c 'toolchain-typecheck -p src/ui/tsconfig.json "$@" & toolchain-typecheck -p tsconfig.json "$@"; specimen=$?; wait $! && exit $specimen' typecheck
scripts.test: mkdir -p work/.vp-tmp && TMPDIR="$PWD/work/.vp-tmp" NODE_OPTIONS="$NODE_OPTIONS --disable-proto=delete --disable-sigusr1" vitest run
scripts.test:ui: mkdir -p work/.vp-tmp && TMPDIR="$PWD/work/.vp-tmp" node --disable-proto=delete --disable-sigusr1 --throw-deprecation --pending-deprecation --force-context-aware --no-global-search-paths --unhandled-rejections=strict "$(command -v vitest)" run --config vitest.ui.config.ts
